```{r}
require(stringr)
require(lubridate)

extract_dates_from_filenames <- function(filenames) {
  results <- data.frame(
    filename = character(),
    extracted_date = character(),
    parsed_date = character(),
    format_detected = character(),
    suffix = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for (filename in filenames) {
    date_extracted <- NA
    date_parsed <- NA
    format_detected <- NA
    suffix_extracted <- ""
    
    # Regex pattern to handle dates followed by whatever random letters/underscores may be present
    date_pattern <- "(\\d{1,4}[-\\./]?\\d{1,4}[-\\./]?\\d{1,4}|\\d{1,2}[A-Za-z]{3,9}\\d{2,4})([A-Za-z_]+)?"
    match_result <- str_match(filename, date_pattern)
    
    if (!is.na(match_result[1, 1])) {
      date_extracted <- match_result[1, 2]  # The date part
      suffix_extracted <- ifelse(is.na(match_result[1, 3]), "", match_result[1, 3])
      
      # Clean the date string
      date_clean <- gsub("_$", "", date_extracted)  
      date_clean <- gsub("\\.$", "", date_clean)    
      
      # Try different parsing strategies
      parsed <- try_parse_date(date_clean)
      
      if (!is.na(parsed$date)) {
        date_parsed <- as.character(parsed$date)
        format_detected <- parsed$format
      }
    }
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      filename = filename,
      #extracted_date = ifelse(is.na(date_extracted), "", date_extracted),
      parsed_date = ifelse(is.na(date_parsed), "", format(ymd(date_parsed),  "%b-%y"))
      #format_detected = ifelse(is.na(format_detected), "", format_detected),
      #suffix = suffix_extracted,
      #stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  return(results)
}


try_parse_date <- function(date_str) {
  date_clean <- gsub("[A-Za-z_]+$", "", date_str)
  
  # First check if it contains text month (like Apr, Mar, Jan)
  if (grepl("[A-Za-z]", date_clean)) {
    parsed <- dmy(date_clean, quiet = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(parsed)) {
      return(list(date = parsed, format = "ddMonYYYY"))
    }
  }
  
  parsed <- dmy(date_clean, quiet = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(parsed)) {
    return(list(date = parsed, format = "dmy"))
  }
  
  parsed <- ymd(date_clean, quiet = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(parsed)) {
    return(list(date = parsed, format = "ymd"))
  }
  
  formats <- list(
    # ddmmyyyy
    c("%d%m%Y"),
    # yyyymmdd
    c("%Y%m%d"),
    # dd.mm.yyyy
    c("%d.%m.%Y"),
    # dd-mm-yyyy
    c("%d-%m-%Y")
  )
  
  for (fmt_list in formats) {
    for (fmt in fmt_list) {
      parsed <- as.Date(date_clean, format = fmt)
      if (!is.na(parsed)) {
        return(list(date = parsed, format = fmt))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(date = NA, format = NA))
}

model <- lmer(Value ~ Class*Stimulated + (1|date) + (1|Groups) + (1|weeks_from_factory) + (1|Timepoint), data = ATP, REML = FALSE)

# Create estimated marginal means
emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Class * Stimulated)

# Get all pairwise comparisons
timepointResultsNormalised <- data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none")) %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c('group1', 'group2'), sep = ' - ') %>%
  mutate(group1 = gsub(' ', '_', group1)) %>%
  mutate(group2 = gsub(' ', '_', group2)) %>% 
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      p.value < 0.1    ~ paste0("  p=", round(p.value, 3)),
      TRUE             ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(Measurement = measurement)

medians_df <-  ATP %>% dplyr::group_by(Stimulated, Class) %>% dplyr::summarize(median = median(Value)) %>% mutate(group = paste(Class,Stimulated, sep ='_'))  %>% .[,3:4] 

factor_df <- medians_df  %>%
rename(group1 = group, median1 = median) %>%
  crossing(medians_df %>% rename(group2 = group, median2 = median)) %>%
  filter(group1 != group2) %>%
  filter(as.character(group1) < as.character(group2))

 for(i in 1:nrow(factor_df)){
  v1 <- as.character(factor_df$group1[i])
  v2 <- as.character(factor_df$group2[i])

      
      # Decide which label should be on the left (numerator) and right (denominator)
      if (grepl("Control", v1) && grepl("LPS", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("Control", v2) && grepl("LPS", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else {
        # fallback: keep original order
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      }
  

      Factor = ((medians_df[medians_df$group == left,  "median"] /
           medians_df[medians_df$group == right, "median"]) * 100)-100 
      Factor = Factor %>% pull(median)
      factor_df$factor[i] <- Factor
      
      
 }
```

```{r}
prune_outliers <- function(data, value_col = "Value", group_cols = c("Measurement", "Stimulated")) {
  # Check if required columns exist
  if (!all(c(value_col, group_cols) %in% names(data))) {
    stop("One or more required columns not found in the data frame.")
  }
  
  # Load dplyr
  if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install the 'dplyr' package to use this function.")
  }
  
  # Use dplyr to group by multiple columns and filter
  library(dplyr)
  
  data_filtered <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    filter({
      Q1 <- quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      Q3 <- quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      IQR <- Q3 - Q1
      lower <- Q1 - 3 * IQR
      upper <- Q3 + 3 * IQR
      .data[[value_col]] >= lower & .data[[value_col]] <= upper
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(data_filtered)
}
```

```{r}
adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Value", "Rep", "Measurement")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data must contain 'Value', 'Rep', and 'Measurement' columns.")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  # Split by Measurement
  data_split <- split(data, data$Measurement)
  
  adjusted_list <- lapply(data_split, function(subdata) {
    model <- glm(Value ~ Rep, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
    
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata$Value)
    subdata$adjusted <- residuals(model) + grand_mean
    
    return(subdata)
  })
  
  # Combine
  result <- do.call(rbind, adjusted_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
find_closest <- function(target_date, choices) {
  # Calculate absolute difference in days
  diffs <- abs(as.numeric(difftime(target_date, choices, units = "days")))
  # Return the original label from the lookup list at the minimum index
  return(lookup_list[which.min(diffs)])
}
```

```{r}
adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Value", "Rep", "Measurement")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data must contain 'Value', 'Rep', and 'Measurement' columns.")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  # Split by Measurement
  data_split <- split(data, data$Measurement)
  
  adjusted_list <- lapply(data_split, function(subdata) {
    model <- glm(Value ~ Rep, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
    
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata$Value)
    subdata$adjusted <- residuals(model) + grand_mean
    
    return(subdata)
  })
  
  # Combine
  result <- do.call(rbind, adjusted_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
i = 1
for (i in 1:dim(df)[1]) {
  plateMap <- df[i,9]
  print(paste(df[i,5], "->", plateMap))
  plateMap = as.data.frame(read_xlsx(paste0("/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/raw_data/IPMAR\ LOAD\ phenotype\ data/IPMAR\ phenotypic\ data\ for\ statistics/plate_layouts/",plateMap)))
  
  small=as.data.frame(fread(paste0("/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/raw_data/IPMAR LOAD phenotype data/IPMAR phenotypic data for statistics/raw_data_singlecell/ATP_calcium/",df[i,4],sep="")))
  small=small[,-c(1:4)]
  colnames(small)=small[1,]
  
  small=small[-c(1),]
  small=small[,!(names(small) %in% "NA")]
  
  names(small)[2:ncol(small)] <- paste0("time_", seq_len(ncol(small) - 1))
  
  if (i %in% c(13,14,15,16)){
      cells=as.data.frame(fread(paste0("/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/raw_data/IPMAR LOAD phenotype data/IPMAR phenotypic data for statistics/raw_data_singlecell/ATP_calcium/",df[i,10],sep=""),skip=15))
      colnames(cells)[3:26]=as.numeric(colnames(cells)[3:26])+1
      cells2=expand_grid(cells$V1,colnames(cells)[3:26])
      colnames(cells2)=c("Column","Row")
      
      normalize_cells <- function(cells1) {
        C = cells1
        
        # If first column looks like row IDs A–P, move it to rownames
        if (!is.null(C[[1]]) && all(grepl("^[A-P]$", C[[1]]))) {
          rownames(C) <- as.character(C[[1]])
          C[[1]] <- NULL
        }
        
        # Drop any column named like "Cell Count" (case/spacing tolerant)
        drop_cc <- grep("^\\s*Cell\\s*Count\\s*$", names(C), ignore.case = TRUE)
        if (length(drop_cc)) C <- C[, -drop_cc, drop = FALSE]
        
        # Keep only numeric columns
        num_cols <- vapply(C, is.numeric, logical(1))
        C <- C[, num_cols, drop = FALSE]
        
        # Fix column names like "X15" -> "15"
        cn <- names(C)
        cn <- sub("^X", "", cn)          # read.csv often prefixes numbers with X
        cn <- sub("^\\s*(\\d+)\\s*$", "\\1", cn)
        names(C) <- cn
        
        # Reorder/complete columns to 1..26 if present
        # (only the ones that exist will be used; missing lookups will become NA)
        C <- as.data.frame(C, check.names = FALSE)
        C
      }
      
      Cnorm <- normalize_cells(cells)
      
      ## --- Build the Wells IDs and fetch the corresponding values ---
      # Ensure cells2 has the expected columns
      stopifnot(all(c("Column", "Row") %in% names(cells2)))
      
      # Compose Wells ID (no separator)
      Wells <- paste0(cells2$Column, cells2$Row)
      
      # Lookup function: row is a letter A–P, col is a number or numeric-like string
      lookup_val <- function(r_letter, c_num) {
        r <- as.character(r_letter)
        c <- as.character(c_num)
        if (!r %in% rownames(Cnorm) || !c %in% colnames(Cnorm)) return(NA_real_)
        val <- Cnorm[r, c]
        if (length(val) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
      }
      
      CellCount <- mapply(lookup_val, cells2$Column, cells2$Row)
      
      cells <- data.frame(
        Well = Wells,
        `Cell Count` = CellCount,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      cells=cells[complete.cases(cells),]
      colnames(cells)=c("Well","Cell Count")
  } else {
    cells=as.data.frame(fread(paste0("/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/raw_data/IPMAR LOAD phenotype data/IPMAR phenotypic data for statistics/raw_data_singlecell/ATP_calcium/",df[i,10],sep=""),skip=15))
  }
  
  
  cell_data <- if (all(c("Well", "Cell Count") %in% names(cells))) {
    # both Well and Cell Count exist
    cells %>% select(Well, `Cell Count`)
  } else if ("Well" %in% names(cells)) {
    # Well exists but Cell Count doesn't
    cells %>%
      select(Well) %>%
      mutate(`Cell Count` = NA)
  } else {
    # neither Well nor Cell Count exist -> create placeholder for all wells in `small`
    tibble(
      Well = small$Well,
      `Cell Count` = NA
    )
  }
  
  # Merge safely — always add a "Cell Count" column even if it wasn't in cells
  small <- small %>%
    left_join(cell_data, by = "Well") %>%
    mutate(`Cell Count` = ifelse(is.na(`Cell Count`), NA, `Cell Count`)) %>%
    { if (!"Cell Count" %in% names(.)) mutate(., `Cell Count` = NA) else . } %>%
    relocate(`Cell Count`, .after = 1)
  
  colnames(plateMap)[1]="Well"
  
  smallID=small
  smallID=merge(smallID, plateMap,
                by = c("Well"),
                all.x = TRUE)
  names(smallID)[names(smallID) == "Cell type"] <- "ID"
  
  smallID$Rep=df[i,5]
  
  smallList[[i]]=smallID
}
```

```{r}
gradient_between <- function(data, t1 = 10, t2 = 25, time = Elapsed, value = mean_value, ...) {
  time   <- enquo(time)
  value  <- enquo(value)
  groups <- enquos(...)
  nm <- paste0("slope_", t1, "_", t2)
  
  data %>%
    group_by(!!!groups) %>%
    summarise(
      !!nm := {
        x <- {{ time }}
        y <- {{ value }}
        
        ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
        x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
        
        if (length(x) < 2) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; y <- y[o]
          if (min(x) > t1 || max(x) < t2) {
            NA_real_
          } else {
            yy <- approx(x, y, xout = c(t1, t2), ties = mean)$y
            (yy[2] - yy[1]) / (t2 - t1)
          }
        }
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

proportion_migrated <- function(
    .data,
    time_col        = "Elapsed",
    value_col       = "mean_value",
    compartment_col = "TopBottom",
    bottom_label    = "Bottom",
    top_label       = "Top",
    method          = c("of_total", "vs_top"),
    summary_fun     = mean,
    group_vars      = NULL
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(.data))
  method  <- match.arg(method)
  agg_fun <- match.fun(summary_fun)
  
  # sanity check
  missing <- setdiff(c(time_col, value_col, compartment_col, group_vars), names(.data))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Column(s) not found: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  
  safe_div <- function(n, d) ifelse(is.finite(n) & is.finite(d) & d != 0, n / d, NA_real_)
  
  # mean and SE per (group, time, compartment)
  summarised <- .data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(group_vars, time_col, compartment_col)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      val = agg_fun(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se  = stats::sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # make wide: bring along val_* and se_*
  base_df <- summarised %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = dplyr::all_of(compartment_col),
      values_from = c(val, se),
      names_sep   = "_"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Top        = .data[[paste0("val_", top_label)]],
      Bottom     = .data[[paste0("val_", bottom_label)]],
      se_Top     = .data[[paste0("se_", top_label)]],
      se_Bottom  = .data[[paste0("se_", bottom_label)]],
      ProportionMigrated_pct = if (method == "of_total") {
        100 * safe_div(Bottom, Top + Bottom)
      } else {
        100 * safe_div(Bottom, Top)
      },
      # NEW: average the two SEs (ignores NA if one side missing)
      se = rowMeans(cbind(se_Top, se_Bottom), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  base_df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(group_vars, time_col)), ProportionMigrated_pct, Top, Bottom, se) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(group_vars, time_col))))
}

adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Value", "Rep", "Measurement")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data must contain 'Value', 'Rep', and 'Measurement' columns.")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  # Split by Measurement
  data_split <- split(data, data$Measurement)
  
  adjusted_list <- lapply(data_split, function(subdata) {
    model <- glm(Value ~ Rep, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
    
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata$Value)
    subdata$adjusted <- residuals(model) + grand_mean
    
    return(subdata)
  })
  
  # Combine
  result <- do.call(rbind, adjusted_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}

chemoData

#filter DRI40 and DRI54 from analysis

#Calculate individual migration rate (i.e. gradient of the line) of each cell line

  summarise(

  )

    TopBottom=first(TopBottom)
  )

# Mixed effects modelling for gradient
```

```{r}
adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Value", "Rep", "Measurement")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data must contain 'Value', 'Rep', and 'Measurement' columns.")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  # Split by Measurement
  data_split <- split(data, data$Measurement)
  
  adjusted_list <- lapply(data_split, function(subdata) {
    model <- glm(Value ~ Rep, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
    
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata$Value)
    subdata$adjusted <- residuals(model) + grand_mean
    
    return(subdata)
  })
  
  # Combine
  result <- do.call(rbind, adjusted_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
morphologyResults <- morphology %>%
  adjust_by_rep() %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(glm(adjusted ~ Class, data = .x, family = gaussian), silent = TRUE)
    
    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p.value = NA)
    } else {
      pval <- summary(model)$coefficients[[8]]
      tibble(p.value = pval)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

max_values <- morphology %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  summarise(Y = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join back to results and add fixed x-position
morphologyResults <- morphologyResults %>%
  left_join(max_values, by = "Measurement") %>%
  mutate(X = 1.5)

morphologyResults$group1="LRWELL"
morphologyResults$group2="HRLOAD"

morphologyResultsAPOE <- data.frame(Measurement = character(),
                                    group1 = character(),
                                    group2 = character(),
                                    p.value = numeric(),
                                    Estimate = numeric(),
                                    signif = character(),
                                    Y = numeric(),  # New Y column
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate through each Measurement
for (measurement in unique(morphology$Measurement)) {
  # Subset data for the current Measurement
  data_subset <- morphology %>% 
    adjust_by_rep() %>%
    filter(Measurement == measurement)
  
  # Loop through each HRLOAD group
  for (i in 1:dim(comparisonsAPOE)[1]) {
    
    # Subset data for this comparison and drop unused levels
    subset_data <- data_subset %>%
      filter(Class_APOE %in% c(comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i], comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i])) %>%
      mutate(Class_APOE = factor(Class_APOE))  # Ensure factor only has two levels
    
    # Ensure exactly two levels exist
    if (n_distinct(subset_data$Class_APOE) == 2) {  
      
      p.value = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[8]]
      Estimate = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[2]]
      
      Y=data_subset %>%
        group_by(Measurement) %>%
        summarise(max_value = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        pull(max_value)*0.95 # adjust position
      
      # Assign significance level
      signif <- case_when(
        p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
      
      # Append results
      morphologyResultsAPOE <- rbind(morphologyResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                       group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                       group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                       p.value = p.value,
                                                                       Estimate = Estimate,
                                                                       signif = signif,
                                                                       Y=Y,
                                                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    } else {
      # Append NA results instead of skipping
      morphologyResultsAPOE <- rbind(morphologyResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                       group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                       group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                       p.value = NA, 
                                                                       Estimate = NA,
                                                                       signif = "NA",
                                                                       Y=NA,
                                                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
  ungroup()

adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c("Value", "Rep", "Measurement")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data must contain 'Value', 'Rep', and 'Measurement' columns.")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  # Split by Measurement
  data_split <- split(data, data$Measurement)
  
  adjusted_list <- lapply(data_split, function(subdata) {
    model <- glm(Value ~ Rep, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
    
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata$Value)
    subdata$adjusted <- residuals(model) + grand_mean
    
    return(subdata)
  })
  
  # Combine
  result <- do.call(rbind, adjusted_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}

morphology <- morphology %>% filter(!ID %in% c('40A'))

morphologyResults <- morphology %>%
  adjust_by_rep() %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(glm(adjusted ~ Class, data = .x, family = gaussian), silent = TRUE)
    
    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p.value = NA)
    } else {
      pval <- summary(model)$coefficients[[8]]
      tibble(p.value = pval)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

max_values <- morphology %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  summarise(Y = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join back to results and add fixed x-position
morphologyResults <- morphologyResults %>%
  left_join(max_values, by = "Measurement") %>%
  mutate(X = 1.5)

morphologyResults$group1="LRWELL"
morphologyResults$group2="HRLOAD"

morphologyResultsAPOE <- data.frame(Measurement = character(),
                                    group1 = character(),
                                    group2 = character(),
                                    p.value = numeric(),
                                    Estimate = numeric(),
                                    signif = character(),
                                    Y = numeric(),  # New Y column
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate through each Measurement
for (measurement in unique(morphology$Measurement)) {
  # Subset data for the current Measurement
  data_subset <- morphology %>% 
    adjust_by_rep() %>%
    filter(Measurement == measurement)
  
  # Loop through each HRLOAD group
  for (i in 1:dim(comparisonsAPOE)[1]) {
    
    # Subset data for this comparison and drop unused levels
    subset_data <- data_subset %>%
      filter(Class_APOE %in% c(comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i], comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i])) %>%
      mutate(Class_APOE = factor(Class_APOE))  # Ensure factor only has two levels
    
    # Ensure exactly two levels exist
    if (n_distinct(subset_data$Class_APOE) == 2) {  
      
      p.value = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[8]]
      Estimate = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[2]]
      
      Y=data_subset %>%
        group_by(Measurement) %>%
        summarise(max_value = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        pull(max_value)*0.95 # adjust position
      
      # Assign significance level
      signif <- case_when(
        p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
      
      # Append results
      morphologyResultsAPOE <- rbind(morphologyResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                       group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                       group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                       p.value = p.value,
                                                                       Estimate = Estimate,
                                                                       signif = signif,
                                                                       Y=Y,
                                                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    } else {
      # Append NA results instead of skipping
      morphologyResultsAPOE <- rbind(morphologyResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                       group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                       group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                       p.value = NA, 
                                                                       Estimate = NA,
                                                                       signif = "NA",
                                                                       Y=NA,
                                                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
}
```

#```{r}
library(tidyverse)

extract_fixed_effects <- function(file){

  txt <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)

  outcome <- basename(file) |>
    sub("_summary\\.txt$", "", x = _) |>
    sub("\\.txt$", "", x = _)

  # ==================================================
  # CASE 1: Standard lmer summary
  # ==================================================

  if(any(grepl("^Fixed effects:", txt))){

    start <- grep("^Fixed effects:", txt)

    end <- grep("^Correlation of Fixed Effects:", txt)

    if(length(end) == 0){
      end <- length(txt)
    } else {
      end <- end[1] - 1
    }

    fe <- txt[(start + 1):end]

    fe <- stringr::str_squish(fe)

    fe <- fe[
      grepl("^Class", fe) |
      grepl("^Stimulated", fe)
    ]

    return(
      purrr::map_dfr(fe, function(line){

        line <- stringr::str_squish(line)

        term <- stringr::str_extract(
          line,
          "^[^ ]+"
        )

        # ==================================================
        # Extract p-value (handles scientific notation)
        # ==================================================

        pval <- case_when(

          grepl("<\\s*0\\.", line) ~
            stringr::str_extract(
              line,
              "<\\s*0\\.[0-9eE\\-]+"
            ),

          TRUE ~ {

            nums <- stringr::str_extract_all(
              line,
              "[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?"
            )[[1]]

            tail(nums, 1)

          }

        )

        tibble(
          Outcome = outcome,
          Term = term,
          Pvalue = pval
        )

      })
    )
  }

  # ==================================================
  # CASE 2: ATP fold-change tibble
  # ==================================================

  if(any(grepl("p\\.value", txt))){

    data_lines <- txt[
      grepl("^\\s*[0-9]+\\s", txt)
    ]

    return(
      purrr::map_dfr(data_lines, function(line){

        line <- stringr::str_squish(line)

        vals <- stringr::str_match(
          line,
          "^\\d+\\s+(.*?)\\s+(0\\.[0-9]+)"
        )

        tibble(
          Outcome = outcome,
          Term = vals[,2],
          Pvalue = vals[,3]
        )

      })
    )
  }

  NULL
}

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

extract_fixed_effects <- function(file){

  txt <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)

  outcome <- basename(file) |>
    sub("_summary\\.txt$", "", x = _) |>
    sub("\\.txt$", "", x = _)

  # ==================================================
  # CASE 1: Standard lmer summary
  # ==================================================

  if(any(grepl("^Fixed effects:", txt))){

    start <- grep("^Fixed effects:", txt)

    end <- grep("^Correlation of Fixed Effects:", txt)

    if(length(end) == 0){
      end <- length(txt)
    } else {
      end <- end[1] - 1
    }

    fe <- txt[(start + 1):end]

    fe <- stringr::str_squish(fe)

    fe <- fe[
      grepl("^Class", fe) |
      grepl("^Stimulated", fe)
    ]

    return(
      purrr::map_dfr(fe, function(line){

        line <- stringr::str_squish(line)

        term <- stringr::str_extract(
          line,
          "^[^ ]+"
        )

        parts <- stringr::str_split(line, "\\s+")[[1]]

        # First numeric column after term = estimate
        estimate <- suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(parts[2])
        )

        # P-value extraction (handles scientific notation)

        pval <- case_when(

          grepl("<\\s*0\\.", line) ~
            stringr::str_extract(
              line,
              "<\\s*0\\.[0-9eE\\-]+"
            ),

          TRUE ~ {

            nums <- stringr::str_extract_all(
              line,
              "[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?"
            )[[1]]

            tail(nums, 1)

          }

        )

        tibble(
          Outcome = outcome,
          Term = term,
          Estimate = estimate,
          Pvalue = pval
        )

      })
    )
  }

  # ==================================================
  # CASE 2: ATP fold-change tibble
  # ==================================================

  if(any(grepl("p\\.value", txt))){

    data_lines <- txt[
      grepl("^\\s*[0-9]+\\s", txt)
    ]

    return(
      purrr::map_dfr(data_lines, function(line){

        line <- stringr::str_squish(line)

        vals <- stringr::str_match(
          line,
          "^\\d+\\s+(.*?)\\s+(0\\.[0-9eE\\-]+)"
        )

        tibble(
          Outcome = outcome,
          Term = vals[,2],
          Estimate = NA_real_,
          Pvalue = vals[,3]
        )

      })
    )
  }

  NULL
}

# ==================================================
# Read all model outputs
# ==================================================

files <- list.files(
  path = "/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/IPMAR Scripts/Final_scripts_for_publication_with_CelllineID/model_outputs",
  pattern = "model_summary.*txt$",

)

      # ATP fold change

      "glycoATP Production Rate (pmol/min)" = "glycoATP_foldchange",
      "mitoATP Production Rate (pmol/min)" = "mitoATP_foldchange"
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# Replace ultra-small p-values

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    Pvalue = str_replace(
      Pvalue,
      "^<\\s*0\\.0000000000000002$",
      "0.0000000000000002"
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# Convert p-values to numeric
# ==================================================

results <- results %>%

    Pvalue = str_remove(Pvalue, "^<\\s*"),

  )

# ==================================================
# Sanity check

if(any(results$Pvalue > 1, na.rm = TRUE)){
```

```{r}
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_33", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      }else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("HRLOAD_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      }else if (grepl("HRLOAD_33", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } 
      Factor = ((medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE_stimulated == left,  "median"] /
           medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE_stimulated == right, "median"]) * 100)-100 
      Factor = Factor %>% pull(median)
      factor_df$factor[i] <- Factor
```
```{r}
}

#IL10 plot

for(measurement in "IL10"){
  measure = strsplit(measurement, " ")[[1]][1]
  data = intensity_normalised %>% filter(Measurement == measurement)

  
  model <- lmer(Value_Norm ~ Class*Stimulated  + (1|ID) + (1|Rep) + (1|Occurence), data = data, REML = FALSE)
  # Create estimated marginal mean
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Class * Stimulated)

# Get all pairwise comparisons
intensity_results_normalised <- data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none")) %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c('group1', 'group2'), sep = ' - ') %>%
  mutate(group1 = gsub(' ', '_', group1)) %>%
  mutate(group2 = gsub(' ', '_', group2)) %>% 
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      p.value < 0.1    ~ paste0("  p=", round(p.value, 3)),
      TRUE             ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(Measurement = measurement)

medians_df <- data %>% filter(!is.na(Value_Norm)) %>% dplyr::group_by(Class_Stimulated) %>% dplyr::summarize(median = median(Value_Norm))

factor_df <- medians_df  %>%
dplyr::rename(group1 = colnames(medians_df)[1], median1 = colnames(medians_df)[2]) %>%
  crossing(medians_df %>% rename(group2 = Class_Stimulated, median2 = median)) %>%
  filter(group1 != group2) %>%
  filter(as.character(group1) < as.character(group2))

for(i in 1:nrow(factor_df)){
  v1 <- as.character(factor_df$group1[i])
  v2 <- as.character(factor_df$group2[i])

      
      # Decide which label should be on the left (numerator) and right (denominator)
      if (grepl("Control", v1) && grepl("LPS", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("Control", v2) && grepl("LPS", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else {
        # fallback: keep original order
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      }
  

      Factor = ((medians_df[medians_df$Class_Stimulated == left,  "median"] /
           medians_df[medians_df$Class_Stimulated == right, "median"]) * 100)-100 
      Factor = Factor %>% pull(median)
      factor_df$factor[i] <- Factor
      
      
}

           gsub("\\.$", "", gsub("\\.?0+$", "", formatC(signif(abs(intensity_results_normalised$factor), 2),

    )

    )
```

```{r}
# APOE split analysis including LRWELL33 

intensity_transferin$Class <- factor(intensity_transferin$Class, levels = c('LRWELL','HRLOAD'))
intensity_transferin$APOE <- factor(intensity_transferin$APOE, levels = c('33','34', '44'))
intensity_transferin$APOE_encoded <- intensity_transferin$APOE

intensity_transferin <- intensity_transferin %>% mutate(
    APOE_encoded = case_when(
      APOE == '33' ~ "33",
      APOE == '34' ~ "34_44",      
      APOE == '44' ~ "34_44",      
      TRUE     ~ "ns"
    )
  )


intensity_transferin$Class_APOE_stimulated <- paste(intensity_transferin$Class, intensity_transferin$APOE_encoded, sep ="_")
unique(intensity_transferin$Class_APOE_stimulated)

# filter to only measurement of interest
relativeintensity_transferin <- intensity_transferin %>% filter(Measurement == 'Spots - Relative Spot Intensity - Median per Well')
Measurement = 'Spots - Relative Spot Intensity - Median per Well'

relativeintensity_transferin$Class_APOE_stimulated <- factor(relativeintensity_transferin$Class_APOE_stimulated,levels = c("LRWELL_33","HRLOAD_33","HRLOAD_34_44"))

model <- lmer(Value ~ Class_APOE_stimulated + (1|Rep), data = relativeintensity_transferin, REML = FALSE)
summary(model)
emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Class_APOE_stimulated)

# Get all pairwise comparisons
intensity_transferin_results_normalised <- data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "none")) %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c('group1', 'group2'), sep = ' - ') %>%
  mutate(group1 = gsub(' ', '_', group1)) %>%
  mutate(group2 = gsub(' ', '_', group2)) %>% 
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      p.value < 0.1    ~ paste0("  p=", round(p.value, 3)),
      TRUE             ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(Measurement = Measurement)

medians_df <- relativeintensity_transferin %>% filter(!is.na(Value)) %>% group_by(Class_APOE_stimulated) %>% summarize(median = median(Value))

factor_df <- medians_df  %>%
dplyr::rename(group1 = colnames(medians_df)[1], median1 = colnames(medians_df)[2]) %>%
  crossing(medians_df %>% rename(group2 = Class_APOE_stimulated, median2 = median)) %>%
  filter(group1 != group2) %>%
  filter(as.character(group1) < as.character(group2))

factor_df$Factor <- 1

for(i in 1:nrow(factor_df)){
  v1 <- as.character(factor_df$group1[i])
  v2 <- as.character(factor_df$group2[i])

      # Decide which label should be on the left (numerator) and right (denominator)
      if (grepl("LRWELL", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("33", v2) && grepl("34", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("33", v2) && grepl("34", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl('HRLOAD_34_44', v1)  && grepl("HRLOAD_33", v2))
  {
        left <- v1
        right <- v2
      } else if (grepl('HRLOAD_34_44', v2)  && grepl("HRLOAD_33", v1))
  {
        left <- v2
        right <- v1
      }

      Factor = ((medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE_stimulated == left,  "median"] /
           medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE_stimulated == right, "median"]) * 100)-100 
      Factor = Factor %>% pull(median)
      factor_df$factor[i] <- Factor

}

intensity_transferin_results_normalised <- intensity_transferin_results_normalised %>%
  mutate(
    pair_key = paste0(pmin(group1, group2), "__", pmax(group1, group2))
  )


factor_df <- factor_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Create a consisent key regardless of order
    pair_key = paste(group1, group2, sep = "__")
  )

intensity_transferin_results_normalised <- intensity_transferin_results_normalised %>%
  left_join(
    factor_df,by = "pair_key"
  ) %>% select(-pair_key)

intensity_transferin_results_normalised$FactorLabel <- ifelse(
  intensity_transferin_results_normalised$signif != "ns",
  paste0(
    intensity_transferin_results_normalised$signif, " (",
    ifelse(intensity_transferin_results_normalised$factor > 0, "+ ",
           ifelse(intensity_transferin_results_normalised$factor < 0, "- ", "")),
    
    # Check if value > 100 to apply scientific notation
    ifelse(abs(intensity_transferin_results_normalised$factor) > 100, 
           formatC(abs(intensity_transferin_results_normalised$factor), format = "e", digits = 1), 
           sprintf("%.1f%%", abs(intensity_transferin_results_normalised$factor))), 
    "%)"
  ),
  NA_character_
)

y_max <- max(relativeintensity_transferin %>% filter(!is.na(Value)) %>% pull(Value))

#filter NS
#intensity_results_normalised <- intensity_results_normalised %>% filter(signif != 'ns')

# Join Y-range to the results table
intensity_transferin_results_normalised <- intensity_transferin_results_normalised %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    Y = y_max + 0.015 * row_number()  # Offset grows with row and y scale
  ) 


# filter to biologically meaningful comparisons
intensity_transferin_results_normalised <- intensity_transferin_results_normalised %>% 
  filter(group1.x != 'HRLOAD_Control' | group2.x != 'LRWELL_LPS')  %>% 
  filter(group1.x != 'LRWELL_Control' | group2.x != 'HRLOAD_LPS')

# ensure labels dont have two % in them
intensity_transferin_results_normalised$FactorLabel <-  sub("(%.*?)%", "\\1", intensity_transferin_results_normalised$FactorLabel)

intensity_transferin_results_normalised$FactorLabel[3] <- 'p=0.26 (+3.0%)'


custom_colors <- c("LRWELL_33" = "royalblue2",
                   "HRLOAD_33" = "salmon2",

)

png(paste("/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/IPMAR\ Scripts/Final_scripts_for_publication_with_CelllineID/fixed_figures/mixedmodelling_transferrin_uptake_APOE_separated.png", sep = ''), width=4,height=4, units ='in', res = 500)
```

```{r}
pvalues_chemotaxis_gradient <- propMigratedbyID_gradient %>%
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, levels = c('LRWELL','HRLOAD'))) %>%
  mutate(p.value = lmer(slope_0_15  ~ Class + (1|Differentiation) + (1|Harvest) + (1|ID), REML = F, data = .) %>% summary(.) %>% .$coefficients %>% .[[10]]) %>%
  mutate(Estimate = lmer(slope_0_15  ~ Class + (1|Differentiation) + (1|Harvest) + (1|ID), REML = F, data = .) %>% summary(.) %>% .$coefficients %>% .[[2]])%>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_slope = mean(slope_0_15),
            p.value = first(p.value),
            Estimate = first(Estimate)) %>%
  pivot_wider(., names_from = 'Class', values_from = 'mean_slope') %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
        p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(percentage_difference_between_groups = round(((HRLOAD-LRWELL)/HRLOAD)*100,1)) %>%
    mutate(group1 = 'HRLOAD',
         group2 = 'LRWELL'
           ) %>%
  mutate(sign = case_when(
        percentage_difference_between_groups > 0 ~ "+",
        percentage_difference_between_groups < 0 ~ "-"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste(signif,
                       ' (',
                       sign,percentage_difference_between_groups, '%)', sep = ''))

library(lubridate)
lookup_list <- c("Jun-22", "Apr-23", "Aug-23", "Oct-23", "Jan-24")
lookup_dates <- my(lookup_list)
find_closest <- function(target_date, choices) {
  # Calculate absolute difference in days
  diffs <- abs(as.numeric(difftime(target_date, choices, units = "days")))
  # Return the original label from the lookup list at the minimum index
  return(lookup_list[which.min(diffs)])
}
```

```{r}
medians_df <- intensity_IBA1 %>% filter(!is.na(Value)) %>% group_by(Class_APOE) %>% dplyr::summarize(median = median(Value))

factor_df <- medians_df  %>%
dplyr::rename(group1 = colnames(medians_df)[1], median1 = colnames(medians_df)[2]) %>%
  crossing(medians_df %>% rename(group2 = Class_APOE, median2 = median)) %>%
  filter(group1 != group2) %>%
  filter(as.character(group1) < as.character(group2))

factor_df$factor <- 1

for(i in 1:nrow(factor_df)){
  v1 <- as.character(factor_df$group1[i])
  v2 <- as.character(factor_df$group2[i])
        # Decide which label should be on the left (numerator) and right (denominator)
      if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD_33", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_33", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      }else if (grepl("LRWELL_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      } else if (grepl("HRLOAD_33", v2) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v1)) {
        left <- v1; right <- v2
      }else if (grepl("HRLOAD_33", v1) && grepl("HRLOAD_34_44", v2)) {
        left <- v2; right <- v1
      } 
      Factor = ((medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE == left,  "median"] /
           medians_df[medians_df$Class_APOE == right, "median"]) * 100)-100 
      Factor = Factor %>% pull(median)
      factor_df$factor[i] <- Factor
}

  mutate(
    pair_key = paste0(pmin(group1, group2), "__", pmax(group1, group2))
  )

  mutate(
    # Create a consisent key regardless of order
    pair_key = paste(group1, group2, sep = "__")
  )

intensity_IBA1_results_normalised <- intensity_IBA1_results_normalised %>%
  left_join(
    factor_df,by = "pair_key"
  ) %>% select(-pair_key)
```

Supplementary mitotracker green figures - MitoG fluo

```{r}
# fdr correction extraction unnecessary since pvvalue is 0.96

require(lmerTest)
intensity_mitog_fluoResults <- intensity_mitog_fluo  %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- try(lmer(Value ~ Class + (1|Differentiation) + (1|Harvest) + (1|ID), data = .x, REML = FALSE), silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(model, "try-error")) {
      tibble(p.value = NA)
    } else {
      pval <- summary(model)$coefficients[[10]]
      tibble(p.value = pval)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

max_values <- intensity_mitog_fluo %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  summarise(Y = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join back to results and add fixed x-position
intensity_mitog_fluoResults <- intensity_mitog_fluoResults %>%
  left_join(max_values, by = "Measurement") %>%
  mutate(X = 1.5)

intensity_mitog_fluoResults$group1="LRWELL"
intensity_mitog_fluoResults$group2="HRLOAD"

intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE <- data.frame(Measurement = character(),
                                   group1 = character(),
                                   group2 = character(),
                                   p.value = numeric(),
                                   Estimate = numeric(),
                                   signif = character(),
                                   Y = numeric(),  # New Y column
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate through each Measurement
for (measurement in unique(intensity_mitog_fluo$Measurement)) {
  # Subset data for the current Measurement
  data_subset <- intensity_mitog_fluo %>% 
    adjust_by_rep() %>%
    filter(Measurement == measurement)
  
  # Loop through each HRLOAD group
  for (i in 1:dim(comparisonsAPOE)[1]) {
    
    # Subset data for this comparison and drop unused levels
    subset_data <- data_subset %>%
      filter(Class_APOE %in% c(comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i], comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i])) %>%
      mutate(Class_APOE = factor(Class_APOE))  # Ensure factor only has two levels
    
    # Ensure exactly two levels exist
    if (n_distinct(subset_data$Class_APOE) == 2) {  
      
      p.value = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[8]]*4
      Estimate = summary(glm(adjusted ~ Class_APOE, data = subset_data, family = gaussian))$coefficients[[2]]
      
      Y=data_subset %>%
        group_by(Measurement) %>%
        summarise(max_value = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        pull(max_value)*0.95 # adjust position
      
      # Assign significance level
      signif <- case_when(
        p.value <= 0.0001 ~ "***",
        p.value <= 0.001 ~ "**",
        p.value <= 0.005 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
      
      # Append results
      intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE <- rbind(intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                     group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                     group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                     p.value = p.value,
                                                                     Estimate = Estimate,
                                                                     signif = signif,
                                                                     Y=Y,
                                                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    } else {
      # Append NA results instead of skipping
      intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE <- rbind(intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE, data.frame(Measurement = measurement, 
                                                                     group1 = comparisonsAPOE$Var1[i],
                                                                     group2 = comparisonsAPOE$Var2[i],
                                                                     p.value = NA, 
                                                                     Estimate = NA,
                                                                     signif = "NA",
                                                                     Y=NA,
                                                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
}

y_offsets <- intensity_mitog_fluo %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  summarise(y_range = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Value, na.rm = TRUE))

# Join Y-range to the results table
intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE <- intensity_mitog_fluoResultsAPOE %>%
  left_join(y_offsets, by = "Measurement") %>%
  group_by(Measurement) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    Y = Y + 0.05 * y_range * row_number()  # Offset grows with row and y scale
  ) %>%
  select(-y_range) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#Generation of the estimated marginal means comparison supplementary table 3

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ==========================================================
# Extract emmeans results from model summary files
# ==========================================================

extract_emmeans <- function(file){

  txt <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)

  outcome <- basename(file) |>
    sub("_summary\\.txt$", "", x = _) |>
    sub("\\.txt$", "", x = _)

  # keep rows beginning with 1, 2, 3, 4 etc
  lines <- txt[
grepl("^\\s*[0-9]+\\s+[A-Za-z]", txt)
]

  
  
  if(length(lines) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(lines, function(line){

    line <- stringr::str_squish(line)

    # extract first two groups
    groups <- stringr::str_match(
      line,
      "^\\d+\\s+(\\S+)\\s+(\\S+)"
    )

    group1 <- groups[,2]
    group2 <- groups[,3]

    # extract all numbers including scientific notation
    nums <- stringr::str_extract_all(
      line,
      "-?[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*(?:e[-+]?[0-9]+)?"
    )[[1]]

    # p.value is normally the 5th numeric field:
    # SE df t.ratio p.value

    pval <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        stringr::str_extract(
          line,
          "-?[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*(?:e[-+]?[0-9]+)?(?=\\s+(\\*|ns|p=|$))")))
    tibble(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Group1 = group1,
      Group2 = group2,
      Pvalue = pval
    )

  })
}
```

```{r}
adjust_by_rep <- function(data) {
  subdata_list <- list()
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_cols <- c(c("ID", "Rep"),measurements)
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Input data is missing some columns")
  }
  
  # Ensure Rep is a factor
  data$Rep <- as.factor(data$Rep)
  
  
  for(measurement in measurements){
    subdata <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[measurement]])) %>% filter(!is.na(Rep)) %>% filter(!is.na(weeks_from_factory)) %>% select(ID,Class, Rep, weeks_from_factory,all_of(measurement))
    formula <- as.formula(paste(measurement, "~ Rep + weeks_from_factory"))
      model <- glm(formula, family = gaussian, data = subdata)
      
    # Use residuals, then add grand mean to retain original scale
    grand_mean <- mean(subdata[[measurement]], na.rm = TRUE)
    subdata[[measurement]] <- residuals(model) + grand_mean 
    

    subdata_list <- c(subdata_list, list(subdata))

   
  }
  reduce(subdata_list, full_join, by = c("ID", "Class", "Rep", "weeks_from_factory"))
  
}
```

prs1 <-read_csv('/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/cleaned_data/Seahorse_assay_data_for_correlation_mitoATP.csv') %>% rename(ID = 'Groups') %>% select(ID,PRS) %>% distinct(.)

prs2 <- read_csv('/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/cleaned_data/LegendPlex_LPS_normalised.csv') %>% select(ID,PRS) %>% distinct(.) 
  
prs3 <- read_csv('/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/cleaned_data/IBA_MFI_for_correlation.csv')    %>% select(ID,PRS) %>% distinct(.) 
  
prs4 <- read_csv('/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/cleaned_data/transferrin_relative_intensity_for_correlation.csv') %>% select(ID,PRS) %>% distinct(.) 

prs4 <- read_csv('/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/cleaned_data/Amyloidbeta_relative_intensity_for_correlation.csv') %>% select(ID,PRS) %>% distinct(.) 

prs_df <- rbind(prs1,prs2,prs3,prs4) %>% distinct(.)

prs_correlations_df <- left_join(correlations_df, prs_df, by = c('ID'))
# remove line 40A and 54A
prs_correlations_df <- prs_correlations_df %>% filter(!ID %in% c('40A'))

# Small correlation matrix for exploration


# define the  columns
target_cols <- c("mitoATP", "glycoATP", "PRS", "IL6", "TNF", "ab42_RI")
custom_order <- c("PRS", "mitoATP", "glycoATP", "IL6", "TNF", "ab42_RI")
matrix <- as.matrix(prs_correlations_df[target_cols])
cor_results <- rcorr(as.matrix(prs_correlations_df[, target_cols]), type = 'pearson' )
cor_results$r <- cor_results$r[custom_order, custom_order]
cor_results$P <- cor_results$P[custom_order, custom_order]

# Extract the pieces
coeffs <- cor_results$r
p_values <- cor_results$P
# here i am replacing all na values, which are the correlations of the object with themselves, with 1
p_values[is.na(p_values)] <- 0

library(reshape2)



coeffs[lower.tri(coeffs)] <- NA
p_values[lower.tri(p_values)] <- NA
cor_df <- melt(coeffs)
p_df   <- melt(p_values)

df <- data.frame(
  var1 = cor_df$Var1,
  var2 = cor_df$Var2,
  cor  = cor_df$value,
  p    = p_df$value
)

# replacing any really small correlation 0.0000000 with 0.000000001 just so that when i take the log it doesnt create an infinite value
df$p[df$p == 0] <- 0.00000000000001

# multiply by 28 comparisons, bonferonni correction
df$p <- df$p * 28 
df$sig <- -log10(df$p)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    p = if_else(p > 0.05, Inf, p),
    sig = -log10(p)
  )

options(digits = 3)

ggplot(df, aes(var1, var2)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = sig, fill = cor),
             shape = 22,
             color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "purple",
    mid = "white",
    high = "orange",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
scale_size(
  breaks = -log10(c(0.05, 0.00001, 0.000000000000001)),
  labels = c("0.05", "0.00001", "< 0.00001"),
  limits = c(0, -log10(0.000000000000001)),
  name = "p-value"
) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +

  ) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
  scale_y_discrete(breaks = custom_order, limits = rev) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = custom_order)

# keep an eye out for correlations between PRS, IL6 and mitoATP
# first lets start by taking the median of repeated measures from the same line

#```{r}
measurements <- c("ab42_RI", "mitoATP", "glycoATP","TotalATP","IL6","TNF")
prs_correlations_df <- prs_correlations_df %>% 
  mutate(
    Class = case_when(
      Class == 0 ~ "LRWELL",
      Class == 1 ~ "HRLOAD"
    ),
    Class = factor(Class, levels = c("LRWELL", "HRLOAD"))
  )

summarized_prs_correlations_df <- prs_correlations_df %>% group_by(ID,Class,PRS) %>% summarise(IL6 = median(IL6, na.rm = T),
                                                                                               TNF = median(TNF, na.rm = T),
                                                       mitoATP = median(mitoATP, na.rm = T),
                                                       glycoATP = median(glycoATP, na.rm = T),
                                                       ab42_RI = median(ab42_RI, na.rm = T))

summarized_prs_correlations_df$TotalATP <- summarized_prs_correlations_df$mitoATP + summarized_prs_correlations_df$glycoATP

plots <- list()
out_dir = '/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/Figures/PRS_correlations'
for (m in measurements) {

  dat_m <- summarized_prs_correlations_df %>%
  select(ID, Class, PRS, value = all_of(m)) 
  if(m %in% c('IL6','TNF')){
    y_axis = paste(m, ' (pg/mL/cell)',sep ='')
  }
  if(m %in% c('glycoATP','mitoATP')){
    y_axis = paste(m, ' (pmol/min)',sep ='')
  }
  if(m == 'TotalATP'){
    y_axis = 'Total ATP (pmol/min)'
  }
   if(m == 'ab42_RI'){
    y_axis = paste('A',"\U03B2",'42 uptake', sep = '')
  }

  p <- ggplot(
      dat_m,
      aes(
        x = PRS,
        y = value,
        colour = Class
      )
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(
      se = TRUE,
      method = "glm",
      method.args = list(family = gaussian())
    ) +
  stat_cor(aes(label = ..rr.label..),    method = "pearson",    label.x.npc = "left",    label.y.npc = "top",    size = 3.5  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    ) +
    xlab("PRS") +
    ylab(y_axis) +
    labs(colour = "Phenotype")

  plots[[m]] <- p
  print(p)  # show each plot as it’s created

  
  plot_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("PRS_vs_", m, "_median_summarised.png"))  
  ggsave(filename = plot_file, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  

  # --- Fit within each group ---
  m_lrwell <- glm(value ~ PRS,
                            data = filter(dat_m, Class == "LRWELL"))

  m_hrload <- glm(value ~ PRS,
                            data = filter(dat_m, Class == "HRLOAD"))

  # --- Extract slopes and SEs ---
  beta_1 <- coef(m_lrwell)[["PRS"]]
  beta_2 <- coef(m_hrload)[["PRS"]]

  se_1 <- summary(m_lrwell)$coefficients["PRS", "Std. Error"]
  se_2 <- summary(m_hrload)$coefficients["PRS", "Std. Error"]

  z_stat  <- (beta_1 - beta_2) / sqrt(se_1^2 + se_2^2)
  p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_stat))

  # Store results
  stats[[m]] <- data.frame(
    measurement = m,
    beta_LRWELL = beta_1,
    beta_HRLOAD = beta_2,
    se_LRWELL   = se_1,
    se_HRLOAD   = se_2,
    z           = z_stat,
    p           = p_value
  )

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Measurement:   ", m, "\n")
  cat("Beta LRWELL:   ", round(beta_1, 4), "\n")
  cat("Beta HRLOAD:   ", round(beta_2, 4), "\n")
  cat("Z-statistic:   ", round(z_stat, 4), "\n")
  cat("P-value:       ", signif(p_value, 4), "\n")
}

# Combine stats into one table
stats_df <- bind_rows(stats)
stats_df

library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

# Format p-values nicely (optional)
stats_df_print <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    p = signif(p, 3),
    z = round(z, 3),
    beta_LRWELL = round(beta_LRWELL, 4),
    beta_HRLOAD = round(beta_HRLOAD, 4),
    se_LRWELL = round(se_LRWELL, 4),

# Above was interesting but the large standard errors make things difficult with the small sample size
# lets try a lmer with batch effects 
#```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)

measurements <- c("ab42_RI", "mitoATP", "glycoATP","TotalATP", "IL6","TNF")
prs_correlations_df$TotalATP <- prs_correlations_df$mitoATP + prs_correlations_df$glycoATP

# Containers to store outputs
plots <- list()
stats <- list()

remove_outliers_iqr <- function(df, measurement, k = 1.5, group_var = NULL) {
  
  measurement <- rlang::ensym(measurement)
  
  if (is.null(group_var)) {
    
    q <- quantile(dplyr::pull(df, !!measurement), probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
    iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
    
    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        dplyr::between(
          !!measurement,
          q[1] - k * iqr,
          q[2] + k * iqr
        )
      )
    
  } else {
    
    group_var <- rlang::ensym(group_var)
    
    df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!group_var) %>%
      dplyr::filter({
        q <- quantile(!!measurement, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
        iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
        dplyr::between(
          !!measurement,
          q[1] - k * iqr,
          q[2] + k * iqr
        )
      }) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }
}

# With outliers

#```{r}
out_dir = '/Users/c1530015/Documents/IPMAR/Figures/PRS_correlations'
for (m in measurements) {

  dat_m <- prs_correlations_df %>%
  select(ID, Rep, Class, PRS, value = all_of(m)) 
    if(m %in% c('IL6','TNF')){
    y_axis = paste(m, ' (pg/mL/cell)',sep ='')
  }
  if(m %in% c('glycoATP','mitoATP')){
    y_axis = paste(m, ' (pmol/min)',sep ='')
  }
  if(m == 'TotalATP'){
    y_axis = 'Total ATP (pmol/min)'
  }
   if(m == 'ab42_RI'){
    y_axis = paste('A',"\U03B2",'42 uptake', sep = '')
  }

  p <- ggplot(
      dat_m,
      aes(
        x = PRS,
        y = value,
        colour = Class
      )
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(
      se = TRUE,
      method = "glm",
      method.args = list(family = gaussian())
    ) +
      stat_cor(aes(label = ..rr.label..),    method = "pearson",    label.x.npc = "left",    label.y.npc = "top",    size = 3.5  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    ) +
    xlab("PRS") +
    ylab(y_axis) +
    labs(colour = "Phenotype")

  plots[[m]] <- p
  print(p)  # show each plot as it’s created

  
  plot_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("PRS_vs_", m, ".png"))  
  ggsave(filename = plot_file, plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  

  # --- Fit within each group ---
  m_lrwell <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ PRS + (1 | Rep),
                            data = filter(dat_m, Class == "LRWELL"),
                            REML = FALSE)

  m_hrload <- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ PRS + (1 | Rep),
                            data = filter(dat_m, Class == "HRLOAD"),
                            REML = FALSE)

  # --- Extract slopes and SEs ---
  beta_1 <- fixef(m_lrwell)[["PRS"]]
  beta_2 <- fixef(m_hrload)[["PRS"]]

  se_1 <- summary(m_lrwell)$coefficients["PRS", "Std. Error"]
  se_2 <- summary(m_hrload)$coefficients["PRS", "Std. Error"]

  z_stat  <- (beta_1 - beta_2) / sqrt(se_1^2 + se_2^2)
  p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_stat))

  # Store results
  stats[[m]] <- data.frame(
    measurement = m,
    beta_LRWELL = beta_1,
    beta_HRLOAD = beta_2,
    se_LRWELL   = se_1,
    se_HRLOAD   = se_2,
    z           = z_stat,
    p           = p_value
  )

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Measurement:   ", m, "\n")
  cat("Beta LRWELL:   ", round(beta_1, 4), "\n")
  cat("Beta HRLOAD:   ", round(beta_2, 4), "\n")
  cat("Z-statistic:   ", round(z_stat, 4), "\n")
  cat("P-value:       ", signif(p_value, 4), "\n")
}

# Combine stats into one table
stats_df <- bind_rows(stats)
stats_df

library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

# Format p-values nicely (optional)
stats_df_print <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    p = signif(p, 3),
    z = round(z, 3),
    beta_LRWELL = round(beta_LRWELL, 4),
    beta_HRLOAD = round(beta_HRLOAD, 4),
    se_LRWELL = round(se_LRWELL, 4),
    se_HRLOAD = round(se_HRLOAD, 4)
  )

table_png <- file.path(out_dir, "PRS_stats_table.png")

png(filename = table_png, width = 2400, height = 900, res = 300)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(tableGrob(stats_df_print, rows = NULL))
dev.off()
